prompt:
A music-video still, 16:9, a medium shot at eye level on a 50mm lens inside an unheated 1920s tenement flat at early morning. Pale blue light comes sideways through a sash window furred with frost ferns on the inside of the glass. An old grandmother sits on a hard chair wrapped in three faded wool blankets, her breath a white cloud, a chipped cup of tea in her lap with a skin of ice on top. The cast-iron grate beside her is swept bare and cold. A masked man called PLUM kneels at her side, turned three-quarters to the camera, draping his chalk-striped mustard-yellow jacket round her shoulders, now in his matching waistcoat and shirtsleeves with black leather gloves and cuffs buttoned. His plum hand-knitted rib-wool balaclava has smooth unbroken knit over the face, a cream chain-stitched ring outlining it, and a small rounded red felt triangle high over his right eye, on the left of the picture. Grey distemper walls, soft grain.

Thanks.
